title: Approve supplier payments
context: You approve supplier payments in a practice system, so no real money moves. Approve a payment only when the purchase order matches, the invoice is attached and the bank account matches the supplier file.

requests.title: Payment request 1
requests.held: Held until Northwind sends the invoice. Nothing is sent.
requests.approved: Approved. Tonight's payment run sends $2,400 to Northwind Print with no invoice on file.
requests.notStopped: Still approved. Tonight's payment run sends $2,400 to Northwind Print.

steps.text: Cancel the payment before tonight's payment run
steps.feedback: Only cancelling stops tonight's payment run.

steps.text: Keep the approval and attach the invoice when it arrives
steps.feedback: Tonight's payment run pays Northwind before the invoice arrives.

steps.text: Ask Northwind Print for the invoice
steps.feedback: Once the invoice is on file, the payment can be approved again.

steps.text: Log the approval as an error, with the reason
steps.feedback: The log shows the team which check was skipped.

requests.title: Payment request 2

checks.label: Bank account in the supplier file

requests.held: Held until Lakeside confirms its bank account. Nothing is sent.
requests.approved: Approved. Tonight's payment run sends $860 to the account ending 1190, which is not Lakeside's account on file.
requests.notStopped: Still approved. Tonight's payment run sends $860 to the account ending 1190.

steps.text: Call Lakeside on the number in the supplier file
steps.feedback: The phone number on the request may belong to whoever changed the account.

steps.text: Change the supplier file to the account ending 1190
steps.feedback: The supplier file is the record you check against. Changing it to match the request removes the check.

steps.text: Cancel the payment before tonight's payment run
steps.feedback: Only cancelling stops tonight's payment run.

colleague.name: Dana
colleague.title: Payment approved by Dana
colleague.summary: Dana, another approver, approved this payment of $1,150 to Harbour Signs and has left for the day. Any approver can cancel it before tonight's payment run.
colleague.approved: Approved by Dana. Tonight's payment run sends $1,150 to Harbour Signs with no invoice on file.
colleague.notStopped: Still approved. Tonight's payment run sends $1,150 to Harbour Signs.

steps.text: Ask Harbour Signs for the invoice
steps.feedback: Once the invoice is on file, the payment can be approved again.

steps.text: Cancel the payment before tonight's payment run
steps.feedback: Only cancelling stops tonight's payment run.

steps.text: Leave it. Dana approved it, so it is Dana's call.
steps.feedback: Any approver can cancel, and Dana has left for the day, so only you can stop the payment.

steps.text: Tell Dana the invoice was missing
steps.feedback: Dana can check the next request the same way.
